original_card.question: Can a decoder deliver the local paid mass in fewer, larger-rank children (block frame climbs instead of rank-1 to rank-3 steps)?
methods: Find one exact small decoding identity whose frame path climbs in blocks, and price its complete per-call profile.
Bound the best effective child rank achievable for one fixed support alphabet, including copies, frames and restoration.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A per-call local profile, with all copied information, frames and restoration counted, whose ceiling exceeds the selected word's by at least 5%; masked or overcomplete supports must change an assumption of the eight-term all-pairs bound. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin. Ideal budget: rank-16 delivery is 2.31x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: Rank-1 children are about half of recursive cost; the selected word's effective child rank is about 3.9. Larger-rank delivery lowers recursive cost per unit of paid mass.
allowed_variations: One masked, overcomplete or block decoder family with exact labels and supports.
A scoped lower bound on effective rank for one alphabet.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Repacking idle remainders of an unchanged word (covered by the packing ceiling).
Repeating the eight-term all-pairs search inside its proved scope.
Only changing helper terminal subspaces and monotone frames within the fixed scalar word, entrances and cleanup contract already covered by #1995/#2013.

Searching below C=40 in the #2017 Eisenstein binary scalar-rectangle or fixed-support block-linear additive pairing model; specify a changed premise instead. This bound does not cover every complex decoder.

Continuing a partial cost improvement while leaving the same unpriced consumer, restoration or central-readout obligation unresolved; refresh the family expansion decision first. Local product-retiming evidence has a narrow scope and is not a ban on changed graphs or contracts.

actual_scope: Can a decoder deliver the local paid mass in fewer, larger-rank children (block frame climbs instead of rank-1 to rank-3 steps)?
bottleneck_link: Rank-1 children are about half of the per-call recursive cost, so larger-rank payload delivery is the lever named by the card's bottleneck. This package prices the lever's exact gate condition: block-climb reblocking lowers the strict-contract moment only at zero charge (co-frame operands, owned gather slots), and the exact minimum zero-charge coverage and taxed-block slack turn the remaining word-level question into a quantitative bar.
stop_rule: Stop after one complete contract-lattice screen at the acceptance target with exact adjacent signs, the four dominance certificates and the small-instance exhaustive check; kill with the exact obstruction if any sign is undecided. No decoder synthesis, no word census, no new construction round.
evidence: RESULT.json: PR3066's seven published moments reproduced; greedy optimality certified by 600 strict merge inequalities and 1225 payload-monotonicity inequalities; 50/50 tax-dominance and 50/50 transport-dominance inequalities at a*; uniform restoration tax excluded (optimal taxed realization is the unchanged selected word, moment 1.000245413040243..); exact thresholds 363 payloads/10 rank-1 units at cap 16 and 255 payloads/14 units at cap 51; coverage-law ceilings 1.467x (cap 16) and 1.820x (cap 51) over the selected ceiling for the zero-charge shapes; omitted-save false-pass and over-law-mass rejection controls; 918-partition small-instance check.

open_questions.question: How many of the selected word's actual 2,412 rank-one payloads are zero-charge co-frame groups with owned gather slots?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It decides the whole lever: at least 363 payloads (cap 16) or 255 (cap 51) must be zero-charge for the +5% gate, with at most 10/14 taxed blocks even at full coverage.
open_questions.first_step: The per-child operand-frame data pass over the pinned t16 word archives named in the README route note, then partition payload pairs into co-frame groups and price exactly those.
open_questions.blocked_by: The archives record operations and a frame registry but no per-child operand frames; deriving them needs a separate frame-propagation and temporary-lifetime pass.

open_questions.question: Does an explicit shared-call transport schedule beat the strict-contract per-block exclusion inside the ten rank-1-unit call budget?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Item 3 excludes per-block charged copies, but shared charged work inside the slack is exactly what PR1605's budget allows.
open_questions.first_step: Declare one sharing schedule and screen its complete profile at a* with ceiling.ceiling().
open_questions.blocked_by: No such schedule is currently proposed.

open_questions.question: What complete profile results if a block climb also replaces the rank-2/rank-3 frame-step children?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Those steps are the 'rank-1 to rank-3 steps' the card names; rank-one-only reblocking cannot reach a = 1/99.
open_questions.first_step: Declare the joint replacement contract and its coverage identity before any synthesis (PR3039 open question 2).
open_questions.blocked_by: The coverage identity fixes paid mass at 72w + 64 per call, so moving step mass needs a proved replacement identity.
